finding: The frozen Scoreline and Snap Cut pair reproduced a Duskblade-only direct-damage interaction on discovery and held-out cohorts. The held-out pilot panel admitted practical activation (lower 95% bound 0.3105 SD), rejected activation under the Ashwarden control (upper 95% bound -0.7752 SD), retained positive aspect separation, added no stalls and reduced Duskblade combat duration by 0.4688 turns on average.
limits: This admits the package at local and short-panel scope only; reachability, independent-policy sensitivity and whole-run balance remain untested.
No protected acceptance or reserve seed was used.
